description:
Dua fotografer. Empat ruangan. Satu malam. Begini cara kami mengatur cakupan tanpa ada momen yang terlewat.

Klien kami adalah grup perusahaan yang mengadakan gala tahunan dengan empat sesi paralel, masing-masing berlangsung di ruangan berbeda secara bersamaan.

Tantangannya: setiap ruangan memiliki momen prioritas. Tidak ada fotografer yang bisa berada di empat tempat sekaligus.

Solusi kami: kami membuat matriks prioritas sebelum event. Setiap sesi diberi nilai berdasarkan kebutuhan distribusi konten, bukan hanya berdasarkan kepentingan internal. Dua fotografer bergerak berdasarkan matriks itu, bukan berdasarkan insting.

Hasilnya: 520 foto terkurasi dari empat ruangan. Tidak ada sesi yang tidak terwakili. Klien menggunakan konten dari setiap ruangan dalam laporan tahunan mereka.

Bagaimana cara kamu biasanya menentukan prioritas coverage ketika ada beberapa sesi yang berlangsung bersamaan?

---

Two photographers. Four rooms. One night. Here is how we managed full coverage without missing a single priority moment.

The client was a corporate group running an annual gala with four parallel sessions, each in a separate room running simultaneously.

The challenge: every room had priority moments. No photographer can be in four places at once.

Our solution: we built a priority matrix before the event. Each session was scored by distribution value, not just internal importance. Both photographers moved based on the matrix, not instinct.

Result: 520 curated images across four rooms. No session was left unrepresented. The client used content from every room in their annual report.

How do you usually determine coverage priority when multiple sessions are running at the same time?

Planning a corporate event? If you need photo/video with clear delivery standards and fast turnaround, message us. We'll share a sample shot list and a clear turnaround timeline.
